explanation: The requested eta electroproduction point is physically impossible at W = 1.45 GeV. In this EXCLURAD eta configuration, the target proton mass is 0.938272 GeV and the eta mass is 0.54786 GeV (see eta/exclurad.F), so the production threshold is W_thr = m_p + m_eta = 1.486132 GeV. Because 1.45 GeV < 1.486132 GeV, ep -> e'p eta cannot occur at any Q2, cos(theta*), or phi*. No input file was generated.
